gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-sofia-sans: Spread-out and glamorous, Stentiga lets every letter breathe, with crossbars as stout as the stems. Sofia Sans, a plain sans with no stroke modulation at all, stands its tall lowercase up in rounded shapes.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-stack-sans-headli: Stentiga's tracking is opened right up, with crossbars as stout as its stems, which gives the heading a refined, luxurious hush. Stack Sans Headline grounds it with a crisp monoline sans skeleton.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-tiktok-sans: Stentiga is a refined display face with wide-set tracking and no calligraphic swell on any downstroke. TikTok Sans reads briskly, its tall lowercase and open c keeping paragraphs moving.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-ubuntu-sans: Luxurious from the first glance, Stentiga stretches its tracking wide and keeps crossbars as stout as the stems. Ubuntu Sans adds big-eyed lowercase and tubular strokes like bent copper pipe.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil reads round and modern, with big lowercase bowls and c and s shapes that look half unwrapped, beneath Visitor. Down a paragraph, the going stays smooth and low-key.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-chivo: Nostalgic and digital, Visitor gapes open on every e. Visitor wins on short ascenders and big bowls; Chivo packs its lowercase up toward the caps, daylight in every curve.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-gidole: Gidole draws neon-tube strokes, with terminals held apart like scissor blades. Visitor's gaping e and short ascenders supply the nostalgic bite, and this sans keeps the text line tidy beneath.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-hedvig-letters-san: Wire-bent and nostalgic, Visitor is all tubular letterforms. Hedvig Letters Sans carries paragraphs gently, small letters nearly as tall as capitals and a clear gap where each c ends.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara keeps its strokes uniform in every direction, with rounded glyphs and spacious terminal gaps. And Visitor's gaping e and solder-pulled strokes supply the nostalgic edge above it.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-huninn: Visitor's strokes are pulled like solder through a nozzle. Huninn, a sans-serif with lowercase rising close to cap height, steadies the text while the heading's gaping e keeps the nostalgia.
